title: acer negundo subsp. californicum
intro: Acer negundo subsp. californicum, commonly known as the California box elder, is a subspecies of the box elder tree native to the western United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and pain, and therapeutic actions such as acting as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of Acer negundo subsp. californicum include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, which contributes to its anti-inflammatory properties. Overall, the California box elder has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions.
